featureFocus: Static Pages and Rich Text Content Management

Page.description: Represents a static content page, identified by a unique `name` and `locale`. It stores the page's `title` and `text`. The `text` attribute is a custom type (`Xikolo::S3::Markup`) designed to manage embedded S3 files within the content. Pages can have multiple language translations linked by their `name` attribute.

interactions.interaction_0: Is created, read, updated, and deleted by `PagesController`.
interactions.interaction_1: Its `text` attribute is processed by `Xikolo::S3::TextWithUploadsProcessor` for embedded file management.
interactions.interaction_2: Its data is formatted for display by `PagePresenter`.
interactions.interaction_3: Interacts with `Xikolo::S3::Markup` for custom attribute handling of text with embedded S3 references.

techDebt: The `rubocop:disable Rails/HasManyOrHasOneDependent` comment on `has_many` associations suggests a potential design choice that might need re-evaluation regarding the lifecycle of translations when a 'parent' page (identified by `name`) is deleted. [Source: app/models/page.rb]

      name: params[:id],
      locale: params.require(:locale)
    )

    processor = process_uploads(@page)

    @page.assign_attributes(page_params.except(:text))
    @page.text = processor.result

        S3FileDeletionJob.set(wait: 1.minute).perform_later(uri)
      end

      redirect_to page_path(@page.name)
    else
      processor.rollback!

Course::Richtext.description: Represents rich text content within a course, typically linked to a `Course::Item`. Manages S3 file references embedded in the text and handles conditional deletion of S3 objects upon destruction.

interactions.interaction_0: Belongs to `Course::Course`.
interactions.interaction_1: Has one `Course::Item` polymorphically as its content.
interactions.interaction_2: Uses `Xikolo::S3::Markup` for its `text` attribute to manage S3 file references.
interactions.interaction_3: Schedules `S3FileDeletionJob` for referenced S3 objects upon destruction, after checking for other references.
interactions.interaction_4: Interacts with `Course::Richtext::Store` for creation and updates.

module Course
  class Richtext < ApplicationRecord
    attribute :text, Xikolo::S3::Markup.new(
      uploads: {purpose: 'course_richtext'}
    )

    belongs_to :course, class_name: 'Course::Course'
    has_one :item,
      class_name: 'Course::Item',
      as: :content,
      dependent: :restrict_with_exception

def self.referenced?(uri)
      ::Course::Course.exists?(['description LIKE ?', "%#{uri}%"]) ||
        ::Course::Richtext.exists?(['text LIKE ?', "%#{uri}%"])
    end

def show
    respond_with Richtext.find params[:id]
  end

def text
    Xikolo::S3.externalize_file_refs(object.text, public: true)
  end

S3FileDeletionJob.description: An asynchronous background job responsible for deleting obsolete files from S3. It is scheduled by `PagesController` with a delay to provide fault tolerance and allow pages to finish loading for users with slow connections.

interactions.interaction_0: Enqueued by `PagesController` after a successful page update that results in obsolete S3 files.

codeBlocks.code:
class S3FileDeletionJob < ApplicationJob
  queue_as :default
  queue_with_priority :eventual

  def perform(uri)
    Xikolo::S3.object(uri).delete if uri.present?
  rescue URI::InvalidURIError, ArgumentError
    # No valid URI, no deletion
  rescue Aws::S3::Errors::ServiceError => e
    ::Mnemosyne.attach_error(e)
    ::Sentry.capture_exception(e)
  end
end

module Xikolo::S3
  class SingleFileUpload
    class InvalidUpload < RuntimeError; end

    def initialize(id, purpose: nil)
      @id = UUID4.try_convert(id)
      @purpose = purpose
      @rejected_files = []
      @accepted_files = []
    end

    def empty?
      return true unless @id

      process!
      (@accepted_files.size + @rejected_files.size).zero?
    end

    def accepted_file!
      process!
      raise InvalidUpload if @accepted_files.size != 1

      @accepted_files[0]
    end

    private

    def bucket
      @bucket ||= Xikolo::S3.bucket_for(:uploads)
    end

    def process!

      # request list of objects

        # receive data

        if valid? object

    class << self
      def bucket_for(name)
        configured_name = bucket_config[name.to_s]
        if configured_name.blank?
          raise ArgumentError.new \
            "Configure the #{name} bucket in Xikolo.config.s3['buckets']!"
        end
        resource.bucket configured_name
      end

      def object(uri)
        parsed = URI.parse uri
        unless parsed.scheme == 's3'
          raise "unknown storage schema in uri: #{uri}"
        end

        resource.bucket(parsed.host).object(parsed.path[1..].to_s)
